normalized.result:
This looks good to me. It covers what I care about most — I can save a link, it'll suggest a title for me, and I can organize things with tags, search for them, mark favorites, edit them, and archive or delete when I'm done. The way it handles a link I've already saved (warning me instead of making a duplicate) is exactly what I'd want, and I like that deleting asks me to confirm first.

One thing I want to make sure of before you build: when I paste a link, I really want it to try to fill in the title for me automatically, so I'm not typing everything by hand. It reads like that's the intent, so as long as that holds, I'm happy.

Go ahead and put together the implementation plan.
